nom: Clinique Redness Solutions Soothing Face Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say it is the only cleanser that does not sting, burn, or leave their face tight, while a few with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report burning, itching, or breakouts within days.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally report the cleanser leaves skin soft, hydrated, and not stripped, though a couple still felt a tight film or no real cleansing after rinsing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers note reduced dryness and no extra oiliness in the T-zone, describing balanced results.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing aging or thinning skin (including one in her 70s) find the cleanser gentle enough for daily double-cleansing and helpful for age-related reactive redness.
segments.normal: A few reviewers without a stated skin problem simply describe the cleanser as soft, fresh, and pleasant to use, with no specific outcome mentioned.

concerns.redness: Most reviewers with redness or rosacea report visible calming, reduced flare-ups, or redness gone within days to weeks; several say results were dramatic, but a notable minority saw no change at all or found their redness worsened.
concerns.aging: Older or peri-menopausal reviewers describe the cleanser as gentle enough for thinning or aging skin and helpful for age-related reactive redness, with no negative aging-specific reports.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out or strip skin and leaves it soft and hydrated, though one reviewer with rosacea and dry skin still felt a tight film after rinsing.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a damaged or reactive barrier (post-retinol, post-Retin-A, post-mask irritation) report the cleanser helped skin recover without stinging or extra irritation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dry, scaly red patches reports the redness and dryness cleared within days; this is an isolated but strong report.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report clogged pores, congestion, or new breakouts (one describing large, congested pores after weeks of use), while others explicitly report zero new breakouts even during regular use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the cleanser does not remove oil well and one felt it did not clean effectively, though it also did not worsen greasiness.

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive skin - caused major inflammation
extraits.texte: I have been using another skin care company for years - however, I like to add the 100H moisturizer and occasionally the Dramatically Different moisturizer. I struggle with redness and constant battle with blemished mostly caused from mild rosacea. I purchased this cleanser along with the matching primer to help neutralize the redness and uneven tone (since it has a green tint). I used ONLY these items for 3 days and had to stop immediately. The burning was unbearable, my face was throbbing and the flare up caused major peeling and worsened the very few blemished areas I had existing. By day 3 I looked horrible and my skin was majorly dry. I heard that there is hydrocortizone in this and maybe the percentage that is used is to much for my skin to handle. Not sure - but I sadly will be returning to Ulta. Im bummed because I thought something with the words SOOTHING or Redness would be what I needed.

extraits.titre: Helped redness but clogged pores. No real cleansing power.
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product, and in fact, purchased it twice. After reading other reviews that the cleanser was more like a lotion and reported to not be very foamy or bubbly, I chose to only use it in the morning, never at night to wash makeup off my face. So my routine became Clinique in the morning, and Purpose face wash (which I've been using for about 15 years) at night, and I felt that I saw improvement in my facial redness! Yay! I was so excited with my new routine I snapped up another bottle on sale...but then...by the end of the first bottle, I noticed that my pores looked larger and upon a closer look, the pores on my nose and cheeks were quite congested and just...well gross. Surely I would have ended up with some nasty blackheads if I had continued on with my routine. It's been a couple weeks since I cut out this Clinique cleanser, and my pores are calming down, looking less congested. My redness is back though. How very disappointing. I would love to return my unused second bottle, but since it shipped with some teeny tiny free samples that I gave away to coworkers, I apparently cannot recieve a refund without shipping back the cleanser AND all the teeny tiny samples. Again, how very disappointing.

I discovered this product several years ago after I had a really bad reaction to a retinol product. I went to the Clinique counter with a severely damaged skin barrier and they recommended the Redness Relief pack. My skin was immediately relieved and it healed in record time. Ever since then, I have been hooked on both the cleanser and the cream. Being peri-menopausal and with very picky and sensitive skin, these products ensure that my skin stay in check. I don't use make up but I use SPF on the daily and I re-apply. At night I do a double cleanse with this beautiful cleanser and just by itself in the morning. It works beautifully, totally recommend.

extraits.titre: The one product I will actually rave about
extraits.texte: For years I have had dry red scaley patches on my face, my hairline, eyelids, and eyebrows were dark red. Super embarrassing and nothing worked. Went to the dermatologist, used items for months that were supposed to work in a couple of weeks to see progress and it did not work for me. Long story short my roommate said I should try it and... when I tell you its the first time I have left the house without makeup to cover the redness for 7 years.... I am not lying. One generous use of it and the redness went away for almost 72 and took care of the REALLY BAD dryness. I saw results in literally 5-7 minutes.

extraits.titre: Gently cleanses my 70 year old skin
extraits.texte: I double cleanse with Soothing Cleanser and Take The Day Off Cleansing Oil. Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm is too heavy for me. The oil helps to remove any sunscreen I am wearing. And because my skin is thinning with age, Soothing Cleanser helps to cleanse and comfort my skin. It's ingredients help to soothe areas of redness on my mid-face and chin, so there is much less reactive redness from using products that are too strong for my skin type.

extraits.titre: Great gentle cleanser, second step for double cleanse
extraits.texte: I double cleanse, first with Take the Day Off balm and then this soothing cleanser. I've been using this for a couple of years now at least, and hope it is never discontinued. I have dry/combination skin that can get irritated so I avoid all foaming cleansers.
Started using this 2 weeks ago and I have almost NO redness! I have dry/combo skin and this has helped with the dryness too and no oily t-zone. Found my new skincare line!
